categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Supezet Engineering Technology Corp., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, manufacturing, installation, and integrated services of specialized equipment for petroleum refining, petrochemical, and natural gas chemical industries. Its main business segments include petrochemical specialized equipment, refining specialized equipment, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) general contracting services, and other products and services. The company offers a full-process service system covering R&D, product development, manufacturing, intelligent operation, and engineering contracting.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced modular and integrated manufacturing technologies, including proprietary modular cracking furnace technology, rare earth heat-resistant steel furnace tube technology, and intelligent production techniques for heat-resistant steel furnace tubes. It employs digital twin, industrial internet, and smart manufacturing platforms to enhance production precision and efficiency. The firm also focuses on green and low-carbon technologies, digital upgrades, and innovative materials development, supported by a comprehensive R&D system and collaboration with universities and research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily in the petroleum refining, petrochemical, and natural gas chemical sectors, including major domestic energy companies like Sinopec and PetroChina. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with products and services covering large-scale refining and petrochemical projects. Its EPC services and specialized equipment cater to large-scale integrated refining and chemical projects, with a growing presence in overseas markets across 16 countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with manufacturing bases in Jiangsu (Jingjiang) and Zhejiang (Daishan), and headquarters in Shanghai. It has expanded its global footprint through acquisitions and international marketing, covering 27 provinces in China and 16 countries overseas, including markets in Europe, the Middle East, and along the Belt and Road initiative countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Supezet operates primarily in the midstream to downstream segments of the petrochemical supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and integration of specialized equipment and EPC services for refining and petrochemical plants. It provides one-stop modular equipment manufacturing and engineering solutions, positioning itself as a key equipment supplier and service provider within the industry value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include innovation-driven development, green and low-carbon transformation, digital intelligence, and global expansion. R&D focuses on new energy equipment, digital twin and industrial internet applications, advanced materials, and process optimization. It emphasizes modular design, smart manufacturing, and lifecycle services, aiming to lead in clean energy technologies, hydrogen metallurgy, and digital upgrades to support China's dual carbon goals and industrial modernization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of specialized petrochemical and refining equipment, EPC general contracting services, and related engineering and technical services. The company operates on a project-based sales model with long production cycles, including contract manufacturing and integrated project delivery. It also earns income from after-sales services, intelligent operation platforms, and technology licensing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the specialized petrochemical equipment manufacturing sector, competing with international giants that dominate the high-end market. It holds a significant market share in China and is expanding internationally. Its competitive advantages stem from proprietary technologies, modular manufacturing capabilities, comprehensive EPC services, and strong customer relationships with major energy companies. The firm is positioned as a technology innovator and integrated service provider in a highly competitive and technology-intensive industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.84 billion, a slight decrease of 4.07% from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 94.77 million, down 38.46%. Total assets grew by 13.86% to RMB 8.71 billion, with an asset-liability ratio of 69.41%. The company has a stable order backlog exceeding RMB 5.87 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures increasing by 21.52% to RMB 113 million, representing 3.99% of revenue. Despite short-term profit declines due to market conditions, the company maintains a solid growth trajectory supported by strategic investments and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Supezet emphasizes its full-process integrated service capability, combining R&D, modular manufacturing, EPC contracting, and intelligent operation to deliver high-quality, customized solutions for complex petrochemical projects. Its proprietary modular technologies reduce construction time and costs while enhancing safety and efficiency. The company’s focus on green technologies, digital transformation, and global market expansion differentiates it as a forward-looking, sustainable, and innovative leader in the petrochemical equipment industry.
